review_notes: 94 existing definitions: exact alpha-token substitutions plus reviewed structured control flow. No new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

MDFC helpers preserve timing and refreshed type reads, current-stack legality, front/back mana query order, free/token/copied flags, stored modes, X propagation, callbacks and transformation rollback. Front card handlers retain target selection and validation order.

Saga preserves ETB/phase setup, humiliation checks, pre/post-increment sacrifice checks, live lore reads and chapter callbacks. Party-size retains the existing class-mask cap and pair-elimination algorithm, which also agrees with the previously recovered count_party_guts helper.

Preserve Blackblade live mode rereads, Whisper marked-sacrifice cleanup, Tiana stored return limits, Slimefoot death/status flow, Zahid payment cancellation, Cabal and Memorial payment/state handling, Curator Ward aura gates and repeated target/cost queries.

Inscription choosers retain repeated kicked and target queries, byte mode flags, Done/cancel handling and original target indices; Nissa, Jace, Soul Shatter and Shatterskull retain live/cached context reads and callback ordering.

Restore ordinary memset initialization for Slinn Voda and Tajuru Paragon. Kazarov stores its pending integer count through info_slot instead of a function-pointer alias. One combined build follows; historical audits, reccmp and inventory regeneration remain deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
